python3 - <<'EOF'
from pypdf import PdfReader
r = PdfReader("report_with_cover.pdf")
print("Total pages:", len(r.pages))
for i, p in enumerate(r.pages):
    mb = p.mediabox
    print(f"\n--- Page {i+1} (size: {float(mb.width)}x{float(mb.height)}) ---")
    txt = p.extract_text() or ""
    print(txt if txt.strip() else "(no extractable text)")
EOF

mv report_with_cover.pdf report.pdf && rm -f add_cover.py && python3 - <<'EOF'
from pypdf import PdfReader
r = PdfReader("report.pdf")
print("Final report.pdf — pages:", len(r.pages))
print("Page 1 text:", (r.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip().replace("\n", " | "))
EOF
ls -la report.pdf
